hypothesis: Memo and portrait/event are resident subrenderers whose actual GETFNT caller and state lifetime can be separated without assuming a new CD module.
setup: Boot without Lua; after the first field is visible, manually load tools/trace_ziria_z6_family_transitions.lua.
capture: GETFNT caller PC and mapped physical bank

criteria.pass: All six routes complete and Memo/portrait ownership can be assigned from actual calls and state transitions.
criteria.fail: A route regresses on the unchanged Z5 baseline or trace proves an assumed host is different.
criteria.unclear: A renderer produces no observed event or the route ends before its lifetime boundary.

result.finding: Memo and portrait/event are not separate renderers; family ownership is separated at the scene-package stream source.

next: Resolve exact stream byte sources before the Z6 build.
